description: Land Acquisition - Helagama, Badulla,  D/S Division, Badulla District and two Other notices in D/S Division, Kalutara & Gampaha Districts
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act for public purposes (construction of a hospital unit and other public works). It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and the legal process for acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
